objective: Keep single and double swing-up and balance as four explicit offline scenarios
known: Single reference contains hardware I/O, not a closed-loop offline plant
assumed: Use acceleration-driven physical pendulum for the new single offline harness

adaptation.plant: Acceleration-driven physical pendulum from P_1_1 linearization
adaptation.balance: Reference acceleration gains; continuous states instead of encoder differences
adaptation.swingup: Consistent upright-zero energy with bounded velocity and stopping-distance guards
adaptation.simulink: Sample/hold and interpreted adapters to shared MATLAB functions

limitations: Offline adaptation is not sample-for-sample hardware controller reproduction
Hardware and voltage loop were not simulated or operated
